You're all under arrest for treason, corruption, and conspiracy.|A secret service officer to [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie Kryze]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] friends|<ref name="The Academy">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref>}}
The '''Mandalorian secret service''' was a [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security organization]], an elite unit of the [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Guard]].

==Description==
They wore [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|New Mandalorian police]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], but with added [[black]] markings on their helmets, [[Armor/Legends|armor]], [[Stun baton/Legends|batons]], and riot shields. They wore a crest on their left shoulder that contained the phrase ''In Defense of Mandalore'' in [[Mandalorian (writing system)/Legends|''Mandalorian'']].

==History==
[[File:MandoSecretService-TA.png|thumb|left|150px|Mandalorian Secret Service officers during the Clone Wars.]]
At some point they were created as a more elite Mandalorian police force, being the middlemen between the regular police and the [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in the investigation of the [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|black market conspiracy]] in the New Mandalorians' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and a team of cadets from the New Mandalorian [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]], several members of the Secret Service turned out to be traitors, in league with [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]].
